The '''Binaros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], specifically the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback]]. Located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> it contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Binaros]].
